AZUSA CITY PLANNING COMMISSION
AGENDA
December 12, 2018
07:00 P.M.
NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

Case No.: DR-2018-18, MUP-2018-28 Location: 295 S. Azusa Avenue, Azusa CA 91702
APN: 8614-014-054
Applicant: Nathan Toobian
Design Review request for the exterior façade improvement and site improvements of an existing Service Station. Minor Use Permit request for the 24 hour operation of the existing Service Station. The property is located in the CSA (South Azusa Corridor) zone.
This project is categorically exempt from environmental review per Class 1 Categorical Exemption (State CEQA Guidelines, § 15301), (California Environmental Quality Act).

Case No.: ADU-2018-12 (New two-story ADU) Location: 239 S. Orange Avenue, Azusa CA 91702
APN: 8614-006-018
Applicant: Carlos Vides
Accessory Dwelling Unit request to construct a new detached 1,199 square-foot two-story accessory dwelling unit (ADU) and attached one-car garage located at the rear of the property. The property is located in the NG2-Low Density zone.
This project is categorically exempt from environmental review per Class 3 Categorical Exemption (State CEQA Guidelines, § 15303), (California Environmental Quality Act).
